questions.cardDe: In welchem Land wird Steak zusammen mit Chimichurri serviert?
questions.de: In welchem Land wird Steak zusammen mit Chimichurri serviert?
questions.en: In which country is steak served with chimichurri?

timeline.labelEn: 19th century: Basque settlers arrive in Argentina and Uruguay, the likely source of the name chimichurri
timeline.labelDe: 19. Jahrhundert: Baskische Siedler kommen nach Argentinien und Uruguay, vermutlich der Ursprung des Namens Chimichurri

questions.notes: Chimichurri is also common in Uruguay; Argentina is the canonical answer (the sauce is 'found originally in Argentina'). No origin date is known; the timeline uses the 19th-century Basque settlement behind the name's proposed etymology.

questions.en: In ancient Greek and Egyptian mythology, a sphinx has the head of a human and the body of which animal?

timeline.labelEn: The Great Sphinx of Giza, a lion with a human head, is made in Egypt’s 4th Dynasty
timeline.labelDe: Die Große Sphinx von Gizeh, ein Löwe mit Menschenkopf, entsteht in der 4. Dynastie Ägyptens

questions.notes: The Greek sphinx is usually also winged; Egyptian sphinxes sometimes have ram, falcon or hawk heads instead.
